sql.query: SELECT * FROM tbl_contracting_entities ce WHERE ce.id=:id AND ce.tenantId=:tenantId AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.roleKey IN ('owner','admin') WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=ce.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1) LIMIT 1
